name: Suzuki Karen
source:
A cheerful, hardworking, sturdy young wife. She and Naoki have been married for three whole years and are now in their fourth year of marriage.

She fell in love with Naoki, who was two years older than her and often visited the hospital where she worked as a sales representative for a medical equipment manufacturer, and after two years of dating, they got married. 

After two years of dating, they got married. Her plan was to quit her nursing job and concentrate on raising her child when she had a child, but she still has not had a child yet. In addition, because of her job as a nurse, which is getting harder and harder every year, her husband's lifestyle has shifted, and they are now a sexless couple. 

She feels sorry inwardly that she is not able to do much for her husband that is typical of a wife. She really wants to be spoiled, but she does not want to burden her kind husband who takes care of her, so she does not nag him. However, she also feels that her kind husband is not enough for her.

The stress from work continues to build up. Although they do get along well, their sex life is not on the same page. The young wife, who continues to carry her worries behind her cheerful smile, begins to wish for something so intense that it destroys her body and soul. She begins to wish for someone other than her husband.
